### Closing Words from Christ
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/closing-words-from-christ
Passage: Revelation 22:12-16
Points:
- Jesus directly proclaims His self-existent deity and eternal nature as the Alpha and the Omega.
- As sovereign Judge, Christ is coming soon to repay all people according to what they have done.
- Those who wash their robes are granted access to the tree of life through persevering faith in the Lamb.
- Impenitent sinners and those who compromise with evil remain excluded from the heavenly city.
- Believers must heed and obey these warnings because they come directly from Christ the Messiah.

### His Judgment Is Just
Author: Dr. Michael Youssef
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-devotional-for-may-12-2025.html
Passage: Revelation 22:12-14
Points:
- Society often prefers a comfortable infant Jesus rather than the glorified Lord who returns to judge.
- Christ's return will be sudden and decisive, ending all future opportunities for salvation.
- Jesus will evaluate how believers have lived their lives and distribute eternal rewards accordingly.
- The Day of the Lord brings great joy to the redeemed, but dreadful ruin to the unsaved.
- Christians are called to watch faithfully and urgently proclaim the gospel before time runs out.
